verdicts.reason: A keeps the bottle-in-cream-circle composition. But the 'Blood Orange Sunset' headline is a tiny line in the top-left corner, NEW and Try It are small and pushed apart along the bottom edge (NEW hard left, CTA off-centre), there is a big dead orange band, and a faint stray circle fragment sits in the top-left corner. B centres NEW and Try It under the bottle, which groups them better. However, it pulls the cream circle away from the bottle and dumps it as a clipped blob in the bottom-left corner, adds the same stray top-left fragment, leaves the headline tiny and left-aligned against a centred column, and makes the CTA undersized. That broken circle is the more visible defect.
